    jq -n --arg repo "$REPO" --arg workflow "$WORKFLOW" --arg cutoff "$CUTOFF" --arg since "${since:-}" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson requests "$API_REQUESTS" --argjson selections "$(cat "$interrupted_dir/selection-ledger.json" 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')" --arg request_hash "$(sha256_file "$interrupted_dir/request-ledger.json" 2>/dev/null || echo '')" --arg selection_hash "$(sha256_file "$interrupted_dir/selection-ledger.json" 2>/dev/null || echo '')" '{schema_version:"sigra.ci-run-metrics/snapshot-v1",repository:$repo,workflow:$workflow,cutoff_utc:$cutoff,window_start_utc:(if $since=="" then null else $since end),status:"incomplete",stop_reason:"interrupted",interrupted_at_utc:$at,request_count:$requests,selection_ledger:$selections,source_sha256:{request_ledger:$request_hash,selection_ledger:$selection_hash},populations:{}}' >"$interrupted_dir/manifest.json"

  }

  fi

  [[ -s "$tmp/branch-protection.json" ]] && cp "$tmp/branch-protection.json" "$stage/raw/branch-protection.json"
  [[ -s "$tmp/rulesets.json" ]] && cp "$tmp/rulesets.json" "$stage/raw/rulesets.json"

  cutoff_epoch="$(jq -nr --arg t "$CUTOFF" '$t|fromdateiso8601')"
  since="$(jq -nr --argjson t "$cutoff_epoch" '($t-2592000)|todateiso8601')"
  local collect_one_population
  collect_one_population() {
    local name="$1" ev="$2" br="$3" out="$stage/raw/populations/$1.json"

    local selected_file="$tmp/${name}-selected.json" filtered_file="$tmp/${name}-filtered.json" pages_file="$tmp/${name}-pages.json"

    printf '[]\n' >"$pages_file"
    while (( $(jq 'length' "$selected_file") < 100 )); do
      endpoint="/repos/${REPO}/actions/workflows/${WORKFLOW}/runs?event=${ev}"

      [[ -n "$total" ]] || total="$(jq -r '.total_count' "$page_file")"

      mv "$pages_file.tmp" "$pages_file"
      jq -c --arg ev "$ev" --arg br "$br" --argjson lo "$(jq -nr --arg t "$since" '$t|fromdateiso8601')" --argjson hi "$cutoff_epoch" '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.event==$ev) | select(($br=="") or .head_branch==$br) | select((try (.created_at|fromdateiso8601) catch -1) >= $lo and (try (.created_at|fromdateiso8601) catch -1) <= $hi)]' "$page_file" >"$filtered_file"
      jq -cn --slurpfile before "$selected_file" --slurpfile page "$filtered_file" '$before[0] + $page[0]' >"$selected_file.tmp"
      mv "$selected_file.tmp" "$selected_file"
      jq -n --arg cutoff "$CUTOFF" --arg population "$name" --argjson page "$p" --argjson ids "$(jq -c '[.[]|.id]' "$selected_file")" --slurpfile previous "$stage/selection-ledger.json" '{schema_version:"sigra.ci-run-metrics/selection-ledger-v1",cutoff_utc:$cutoff,populations:($previous[0].populations | map(select(.population!=$population)) + [{population:$population,last_page:$page,selected_run_ids:$ids}])}' >"$stage/selection-ledger.json.tmp" && mv "$stage/selection-ledger.json.tmp" "$stage/selection-ledger.json"
      sync "$stage/selection-ledger.json" 2>/dev/null || sync 2>/dev/null || true

    done
    total="${total:-0}"

    mv "$selected_file.capped" "$selected_file"
    selected_count="$(jq 'length' "$selected_file")"

    (( total > selected_count )) && capped=true
    [[ "$capped" == false ]] && exhausted=true
    jq -n --arg name "$name" --arg event "$ev" --arg branch "$br" --arg since "$since" --arg cutoff "$CUTOFF" --argjson total "$total" --slurpfile selected "$selected_file" --slurpfile pages "$pages_file" --argjson capped "$capped" --argjson exhausted "$exhausted" '{population:$name,event:$event,branch:(if $branch=="" then null else $branch end),created_window:{after:$since,before:$cutoff},api_total_count:$total,population_capped:$capped,population_exhausted:$exhausted,selected_run_ids:[$selected[0][].id],runs:$selected[0],pages:$pages[0],detail_status:"pending"}' >"$out"
    api_write_ledger collecting
  }

  collect_attempt_details() {
    local selected failed priority all_rows row id event run attempts attempt needed family_dir jobs_file jobs_status attempts_json paths_status paths_json pr_number docs_flag docs_rule skip_seen workload details_json details_file enrichments='[]' reserve=108 max_attempt measurement_target
    local selected_file="$tmp/all-selected-runs.json" failed_file="$tmp/failed-selected-runs.json" priority_file="$tmp/prioritized-runs.json" enrichments_file="$tmp/family-enrichments.json"
    jq -cn --slurpfile pr "$stage/raw/populations/pull_request.json" --slurpfile push "$stage/raw/populations/push_main.json" --slurpfile night "$stage/raw/populations/schedule.json" '[($pr[0].runs[]|{population:"pull_request",run:.}),($push[0].runs[]|{population:"push_main",run:.}),($night[0].runs[]|{population:"schedule",run:.})]' >"$selected_file"
    jq -c '[.[] | select(.run.conclusion=="failure") | select(.population=="pull_request" or .population=="push_main" or .population=="schedule")] | sort_by(.run.created_at) | reverse | .[0:12]' "$selected_file" >"$failed_file"
    measurement_target="$(jq -r '[.[] | select(.population=="pull_request" and .run.conclusion=="success")] | sort_by(.run.created_at) | reverse | .[0].run.id // empty' "$selected_file")"
    jq -cn --arg target "$measurement_target" --slurpfile failed "$failed_file" --slurpfile selected "$selected_file" '
      ($selected[0] | sort_by(.run.created_at) | reverse) as $ordered |
      ([($ordered | map(select(.population=="pull_request" and (.run.id|tostring)==$target)) | .[0]),($ordered | map(select(.population=="push_main" and .run.conclusion=="success")) | .[0]),($ordered | map(select(.population=="schedule" and .run.conclusion=="success")) | .[0])] | map(select(.!=null)) | unique_by([.population,.run.id])) as $anchors |
      ($selected[0] | .[0:3]) as $recent |

    ' "$selected_file" >"$priority_file"
    printf '[]\n' >"$enrichments_file"

    while IFS= read -r row; do

      if [[ ! "$id" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || ! "$attempts" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || (( attempts > 100 )); then

      family_dir="$stage/raw/families/$id"

      needed="$attempts"
      # Reserve a bounded pass for the twelve newest failed families: at most
      # one artifact metadata read, and the initial request plus three possible

collect_family() {
  [[ "$REPO" == "szTheory/sigra" ]] || fail "collect_repo_mismatch"
  [[ "$WORKFLOW" == "ci.yml" ]] || fail "collect_workflow_mismatch"
  [[ "$RUN_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "collect_requires_numeric_run_id"
  [[ -n "$SOURCE_BUNDLE" ]] || fail "collect_requires_source_bundle"
  [[ ! -e "$SOURCE_BUNDLE" ]] || fail "source_bundle_already_exists"
  mkdir -p "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw"
  API_LEDGER="$SOURCE_BUNDLE/request-ledger.json"
  API_STARTED="$(date +%s)"
  API_COMPLETED=false
  API_REQUEST_LOG='[]'
  if [[ "${CI_METRICS_TEST_MODE:-0}" == 1 && "${CI_METRICS_TEST_PRIOR_REQUESTS:-}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( CI_METRICS_TEST_PRIOR_REQUESTS <= 600 )); then API_REQUESTS="$CI_METRICS_TEST_PRIOR_REQUESTS"; else API_REQUESTS=0; fi
  api_write_ledger collecting
  local tmp branch_protection effective_rules rulesets run jobs checks source_sha state branch clean workflow_hash cutoff local_sha local_branch
  tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
  API_TEMP_DIR="$tmp"
  trap api_cleanup EXIT
  trap 'api_write_ledger incomplete; [[ -n "$API_TEMP_DIR" && -d "$API_TEMP_DIR" ]] && rm -rf "$API_TEMP_DIR"; exit 130' INT TERM HUP
  # First live request itself goes through the shared cap/clock/retry helper.
  if ! api_get rate_limit "$tmp/rate-limit.json"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$API_UNKNOWN" >"$SOURCE_BUNDLE/missing-capabilities.json"
    return 1
  fi
  # Fetch active ruleset discovery and effective branch rules under the same guard.
  if ! api_get "/repos/${REPO}/rules/branches/${TARGET_BRANCH}" "$tmp/effective-rules.json"; then
    api_stop branch_rules_unavailable "" "effective branch rules"
  else
    cp "$tmp/effective-rules.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/effective-rules.json"
  fi
  if ! api_get "/repos/${REPO}/branches/${TARGET_BRANCH}/protection/required_status_checks" "$tmp/branch-protection.json"; then
    if [[ "$API_LAST_ERROR" =~ 404 ]]; then
      jq -n '{status:"not_configured",http_status:404}' >"$tmp/branch-protection.json"
      API_STOP_REASON=""
      API_UNKNOWN='[]'
    else
      api_stop branch_protection_unavailable "" "branch protection"
      printf '%s\n' "$API_UNKNOWN" >"$SOURCE_BUNDLE/missing-capabilities.json"
      return 1
    fi
  else
    cp "$tmp/branch-protection.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/branch-protection.json"
  fi
  cp "$tmp/branch-protection.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/branch-protection.json"
  if ! api_get "/repos/${REPO}/rulesets?per_page=100" "$tmp/rulesets.json"; then
    api_stop active_rulesets_unavailable "" "active rulesets"
  else
    cp "$tmp/rulesets.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/rulesets.json"
  fi
  if ! api_get "/repos/${REPO}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}" "$tmp/run.json"; then
    api_stop run_metadata_unavailable "" "workflow run"
  else
    cp "$tmp/run.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/run.json"
  fi
  run="$tmp/run.json"
  source_sha="$(jq -r '.head_sha // empty' "$run")"
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.id // empty' "$run")" != "$RUN_ID" || -z "$source_sha" || "$(jq -r '.run_attempt // empty' "$run")" == "" || "$(jq -r '.event // empty' "$run")" != "pull_request" || "$(jq -r '.path // ""' "$run")" != ".github/workflows/ci.yml" || "$(jq -r '.repository.id // empty' "$run")" != 1207487684 ]]; then
    api_stop run_identity_mismatch "" "run identity"
  fi
  local attempt_id
  attempt_id="$(jq -r '.run_attempt' "$run")"
  local all_jobs='[]' attempt_num
  for ((attempt_num=1; attempt_num<=attempt_id; attempt_num++)); do
    if ! api_get "/repos/${REPO}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}/attempts/${attempt_num}/jobs?per_page=100" "$tmp/jobs-attempt-${attempt_num}.json"; then
      api_stop jobs_unavailable "" "attempt ${attempt_num} jobs"
      printf '%s\n' "$API_UNKNOWN" >"$SOURCE_BUNDLE/missing-capabilities.json"
      return 1
    fi
    cp "$tmp/jobs-attempt-${attempt_num}.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/jobs-attempt-${attempt_num}.json"
    all_jobs="$(jq -cn --argjson attempt "$attempt_num" --argjson prior "$all_jobs" --slurpfile current "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/jobs-attempt-${attempt_num}.json" '$prior + (($current[0].jobs // []) | map(. + {attempt:$attempt}))')"
  done
  jq -cn --argjson jobs "$all_jobs" '{jobs:$jobs}' >"$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/jobs.json"
  if ! api_get "/repos/${REPO}/commits/${source_sha}/check-runs?per_page=100" "$tmp/check-runs.json"; then
    api_stop check_runs_unavailable "" "check runs"
  else
    cp "$tmp/check-runs.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/check-runs.json"
  fi
  local approved required actual required_json rules_changed required_info job_cost last_required diagnostics attempt_hashes
  approved="$(approved_required_contexts)"
  required_info="$(derive_required_contexts "$tmp/effective-rules.json" "$tmp/branch-protection.json")"
  actual="$(jq -c '.actual' <<<"$required_info")"
  required_json="$actual"
  rules_changed="$(jq -r '.changed' <<<"$required_info")"
  cp "$tmp/rate-limit.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/rate-limit.json"
  cp "$tmp/branch-protection.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/branch-protection.json"
  cp "$tmp/effective-rules.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/effective-rules.json"
  cp "$tmp/rulesets.json" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/rulesets.json"
  attempt_hashes='{}'
  for ((attempt_num=1; attempt_num<=attempt_id; attempt_num++)); do
    attempt_hashes="$(jq -cn --arg key "jobs_attempt_${attempt_num}" --arg hash "$(sha256_file "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/jobs-attempt-${attempt_num}.json")" --argjson prior "$attempt_hashes" '$prior + {($key):$hash}')"
  done
  # Bundle every raw response with hashes before computing any timing.
  jq -n --arg repo "$REPO" --arg workflow "$WORKFLOW" --argjson run_id "$RUN_ID" \
    --argjson attempt "$attempt_id" --arg sha "$source_sha" --argjson rules "$required_json" \
    --argjson expected "$approved" --argjson rules_changed "$rules_changed" --arg required_source "$(jq -r '.source' <<<"$required_info")" --argjson rules_diagnostics "$(jq -c '.diagnostics' <<<"$required_info")" \
    --argjson rulesets "$(jq -c '[.[]? | select(.enforcement=="active") | {id,name,target,enforcement}]' "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/rulesets.json")" \
    --arg branch "$(jq -r '.head_branch // empty' "$run")" --arg url "$(jq -r '.html_url // empty' "$run")" \
    --arg conclusion "$(jq -r '.conclusion // empty' "$run")" --argjson all_attempts "$attempt_id" \
    --arg run_hash "$(sha256_file "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/run.json")" \
    --arg jobs_hash "$(sha256_file "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/jobs.json")" \
    --arg checks_hash "$(sha256_file "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/check-runs.json")" \
    --arg rules_hash "$(sha256_file "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/effective-rules.json")" \
    --arg protection_hash "$(sha256_file "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/branch-protection.json")" \
    --arg rulesets_hash "$(sha256_file "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/rulesets.json")" \
    --arg rate_hash "$(sha256_file "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/raw/rate-limit.json")" --argjson attempt_hashes "$attempt_hashes" \
    '{schema_version:"sigra.ci-run-metrics/family-v1",repository:$repo,workflow:$workflow,event:"pull_request",branch:$branch,run_id:$run_id,attempt:$attempt,attempts_collected:$all_attempts,source_sha:$sha,revisions:[{source_sha:$sha,run_id:$run_id,attempt:$attempt,associated_pull_requests:[]}],run_url:$url,literal_conclusion:$conclusion,required_contexts:$rules,approved_contexts:$expected,required_context_source:$required_source,required_rules_changed:$rules_changed,required_rules_diagnostics:$rules_diagnostics,active_rulesets:$rulesets,raw_sha256:($attempt_hashes + {run:$run_hash,jobs:$jobs_hash,check_runs:$checks_hash,effective_rules:$rules_hash,branch_protection:$protection_hash,rulesets:$rulesets_hash,rate_limit:$rate_hash})}' >"$SOURCE_BUNDLE/manifest.json"
  rm -rf "$tmp"
  api_write_ledger complete
  jq --arg sha256 "$(sha256_file "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/request-ledger.json")" '.request_ledger_sha256=$sha256' "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/manifest.json" >"$SOURCE_BUNDLE/manifest.json.tmp"
  mv "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/manifest.json.tmp" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE/manifest.json"
  API_COMPLETED=true
  API_TEMP_DIR=""
  trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP
  replay_family "$SOURCE_BUNDLE" json
}

run_preflight() {
  [[ -n "$PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT" ]] || fail "--preflight requires --preflight-output"
  API_LEDGER="${PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT%.json}-request-ledger.json"
  API_STARTED="$(date +%s)"
  API_COMPLETED=false
  API_REQUEST_LOG='[]'
  if [[ "${CI_METRICS_TEST_MODE:-0}" == 1 && "${CI_METRICS_TEST_PRIOR_REQUESTS:-}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( CI_METRICS_TEST_PRIOR_REQUESTS <= 600 )); then API_REQUESTS="$CI_METRICS_TEST_PRIOR_REQUESTS"; else API_REQUESTS=0; fi
  API_STOP_REASON=""
  API_RESET_AT=""
  API_CORE_REMAINING=""
  API_UNKNOWN='[]'
  API_LAST_ERROR=""
  local tmp sha branch dirty workflow_hash utc cutoff status missing effective rulesets protection approved current status_code capability toolchain ruleset_provenance
  tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
  API_TEMP_DIR="$tmp"
  trap api_cleanup EXIT
  trap 'api_write_ledger incomplete; [[ -n "$API_TEMP_DIR" && -d "$API_TEMP_DIR" ]] && rm -rf "$API_TEMP_DIR"; exit 130' INT TERM HUP
  utc="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  cutoff="$utc"
  sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  branch="$(git branch --show-current)"
  dirty="$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length>0))')"
  workflow_hash="$(git hash-object .github/workflows/ci.yml)"
  local gh_version pins
  gh_version="$(GH_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 gh --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo unavailable)"
  pins="$(tr '\n' ';' <.tool-versions 2>/dev/null || echo unavailable)"
  toolchain="$(jq -cn --arg gh_path "$(command -v gh || echo unavailable)" --arg gh "$gh_version" --arg bash "$BASH_VERSION" --arg jq "$(jq --version 2>/dev/null || echo unavailable)" --arg project_pins "$pins" '{gh_path:$gh_path,gh:$gh,bash:$bash,jq:$jq,project_runtime_pins:$project_pins}')"
  approved="$(approved_required_contexts)"
  missing='[]'
  status=ready
  if ! api_get rate_limit "$tmp/rate-limit.json"; then
    status=blocked; missing="$(jq -cn --arg reason "$API_STOP_REASON" '["github_rate_limit_preflight:"+$reason]')"
  fi
  if [[ "$status" == ready ]]; then
    if api_get "/repos/${REPO}/branches/${TARGET_BRANCH}/protection/required_status_checks" "$tmp/branch-protection.json"; then
      cp "$tmp/branch-protection.json" "${PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT%.json}-branch-protection.json"
    elif [[ "$API_LAST_ERROR" =~ 404 ]]; then
      jq -n '{status:"not_configured",http_status:404}' >"$tmp/branch-protection.json"
      cp "$tmp/branch-protection.json" "${PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT%.json}-branch-protection.json"
      API_STOP_REASON=""
      API_UNKNOWN='[]'
    else
      status=blocked; missing="$(jq -cn --arg reason "$API_STOP_REASON" '["branch_protection_source:"+$reason]')"
    fi
  fi
  if [[ "$status" == ready ]]; then
    if api_get "/repos/${REPO}/rules/branches/${TARGET_BRANCH}" "$tmp/effective-rules.json"; then
      cp "$tmp/effective-rules.json" "${PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT%.json}-effective-rules.json"
    else
      status=blocked; missing="$(jq -cn --arg reason "$API_STOP_REASON" '["effective_branch_rules_source:"+$reason]')"
    fi
  fi
  if [[ "$status" == ready ]]; then
    if api_get "/repos/${REPO}/rulesets?per_page=100" "$tmp/rulesets.json"; then
      cp "$tmp/rulesets.json" "${PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT%.json}-active-rulesets.json"
      ruleset_provenance="$(jq -c '[.[]? | select(.enforcement=="active") | {id,name,target,enforcement}]' "$tmp/rulesets.json")"
    else
      status=blocked; missing="$(jq -cn --arg reason "$API_STOP_REASON" '["active_rulesets_source:"+$reason]')"
    fi
  fi
  [[ -n "${ruleset_provenance:-}" ]] || ruleset_provenance='[]'
  required_info="$(derive_required_contexts "$tmp/effective-rules.json" "$tmp/branch-protection.json")"
  current="$(jq -c '.actual' <<<"$required_info")"
  if [[ "$status" == ready && "$(jq -r '.changed' <<<"$required_info")" == true ]]; then
    status=blocked
    missing="$(jq -cn --argjson expected "$approved" --argjson actual "$current" '[{reason:"required_rules_changed",expected:$expected,actual:$actual}]')"
  fi
  api_write_ledger "$([[ "$status" == ready ]] && echo complete || echo incomplete)"
  jq -n --arg status "$status" --arg checkout_sha "$sha" --arg branch "$branch" \
    --arg workflow_blob_sha "$workflow_hash" --arg cutoff "$cutoff" --arg captured_at "$utc" \
    --argjson dirty_paths "$dirty" --argjson toolchain "$toolchain" --argjson expected "$approved" \
    --argjson current "$current" --argjson active_rulesets "$ruleset_provenance" --argjson missing "$missing" --argjson requests "$API_REQUESTS" \
    --arg core_remaining "$API_CORE_REMAINING" --arg core_reset "$API_RESET_AT" \
    --arg ledger "$API_LEDGER" --arg run_url "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID:-38144377407}" \
    --arg rules_url "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/rules/branches/${TARGET_BRANCH}" \
    --arg rulesets_url "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/rulesets" \
    --arg branch_protection_url "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/branches/${TARGET_BRANCH}/protection/required_status_checks" \
    '{schema_version:"sigra.ci-run-metrics/preflight-v1",status:$status,checkout:{sha:$checkout_sha,branch:$branch,dirty_paths:$dirty_paths},workflow:{path:".github/workflows/ci.yml",git_blob_sha:$workflow_blob_sha},toolchain:$toolchain,source_urls:{workflow_run:$run_url,effective_branch_rules:$rules_url,branch_protection:$branch_protection_url,active_rulesets:$rulesets_url},cutoff_utc:$cutoff,captured_at_utc:$captured_at,expected_required_contexts:$expected,effective_required_contexts:$current,required_rules_changed:(($current|sort) != ($expected|sort)),active_rulesets:$active_rulesets,core_rate_remaining:(try ($core_remaining|tonumber) catch null),core_rate_reset_at:(try ($core_reset|tonumber) catch null),request_count:$requests,request_ledger:$ledger,missing_capabilities:$missing}' \
    >"${PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT}.tmp" && mv "${PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT}.tmp" "$PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT"
  rm -rf "$tmp"
  API_COMPLETED=true
  API_TEMP_DIR=""
  trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP
  [[ "$status" == ready ]] || return 2
  return 0
}

register_comparison_run() {

    $s.query.created == ($since + ".." + $until) and $s.query.per_page == 100 and
    ($s.requested_pages | type == "array" and length == ($s.pages | length) and . == [range(1; length + 1)]) and
    ([$s.pages[].page] == $s.requested_pages) and
    $s.terminal_page == ($s.requested_pages[-1]) and $s.exhausted == true and
    ($s.pages | type == "array" and length > 0) and
    all($s.pages[]; (.page | type) == "number" and
      (.returned_count | type) == "number" and (.runs | type) == "array" and .returned_count == (.runs | length)) and
    all($s.pages[0:-1][]; .returned_count > 0) and
    ($s.pages[-1].returned_count == 0) and
    all($s.pages[].runs[];
      (.run_id | type) == "number" and (.url | type) == "string" and (.url | length) > 0 and
      (.event | type) == "string" and
      ((.conclusion == null) or ((.conclusion | type) == "string" and (.conclusion | length) > 0)) and
      (.created_at | type) == "string" and (.updated_at | type) == "string") and
    ([$s.pages[].runs[].run_id] | length == (unique | length))
  ' "$SOURCE_PAGES" >/dev/null || fail "source_pages_shape_invalid"

  SOURCE_RESULT="$(jq -e --arg since "$SINCE" --arg until "$UNTIL" --argjson threshold "$THRESHOLD" '
    [.pages[].runs[]
      | select(.event == "pull_request" and (.conclusion | type) == "string" and (.conclusion | length) > 0)
      | select(.created_at >= $since and .created_at <= $until)
      | (((.created_at | fromdateiso8601) // error("created_at_invalid")) as $created
        | ((.updated_at | fromdateiso8601) // error("updated_at_invalid")) as $updated
        | if $updated < $created then error("run_chronology_invalid") else . end
        | . + {wall_seconds: ($updated - $created)})]
    | sort_by(.wall_seconds, .run_id) as $runs
    | ($runs | length) as $n
    | if $n < 10 then
        {runs:$runs, eligible_pr_run_count:$n, statistics:null, selected_poles:null,
         verdict:null, status:"insufficient_population",
         diagnostics:["requires_at_least_10_terminal_pull_request_runs"]}
      else
        ($runs[($n / 2 | floor)]) as $median
        | ($runs[-1]) as $maximum
        | (($runs | map(.wall_seconds) | add) / $n) as $mean
        | {runs:$runs, eligible_pr_run_count:$n,
           statistics:{mode:"wall",ordering:"{wall_seconds, run_id}",mean_seconds:$mean,
             p50_seconds:$median.wall_seconds,max_seconds:$maximum.wall_seconds,
             outcomes:($runs | group_by(.conclusion) | map({key:.[0].conclusion,value:length}) | from_entries)},
           selected_poles:{median_run_id:$median.run_id,maximum_run_id:$maximum.run_id},
           verdict:(if $n < 10 then null elif $median.wall_seconds < $threshold then "pass" else "miss" end),
           status:(if $n < 10 then "insufficient_population" else "measured" end),
           diagnostics:(if $n < 10 then ["requires_at_least_10_terminal_pull_request_runs"] else [] end)}
      end
    | {schema_version:"sigra.ci-run-metrics/source-pages-v1",mode:"wall",event:"pull_request",
       since:$since,until:$until,threshold_seconds:$threshold} + .
  ' "$SOURCE_PAGES")" || fail "source_pages_semantics_invalid"
  printf '%s\n' "$SOURCE_RESULT" | jq -S .
  exit 0
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Single-run mode: --jobs <run_id>
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -n "$RUN_ID" ]]; then
  JOBS_JSON="$(gh run view "$RUN_ID" --repo "$REPO" --json jobs --jq '.jobs')" || fail "gh run view failed for run ${RUN_ID}"

  JOB_COUNT="$(echo "$JOBS_JSON" | jq 'length')"
  if [[ -z "$JOB_COUNT" || "$JOB_COUNT" -eq 0 ]]; then
    fail "run ${RUN_ID} has an empty job list"
  fi

  DURATION_JQ='
    .[] as $j
    | (($j.completedAt|fromdate) - ($j.startedAt|fromdate)) as $raw
    | (if $raw < 0 then 0 else $raw end) as $dur
  '

  case "$FORMAT" in
    json)
      echo "$JOBS_JSON" | jq "[ ${DURATION_JQ} | {name: \$j.name, conclusion: \$j.conclusion, duration_seconds: \$dur} ]"
      ;;
    table)
      {
        printf 'job\tconclusion\tduration_s\tduration\n'
        echo "$JOBS_JSON" | jq -r "
          ${DURATION_JQ}
          | (\$dur / 60 | floor) as \$m
          | (\$dur - (\$m * 60)) as \$s
          | \"\(\$j.name)\t\(\$j.conclusion)\t\(\$dur)s\t\(\$m)m\(\$s)s\"
        "
      } | column -t -s $'\t'
      ;;
  esac
  exit 0
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Window mode: baseline-reproduction (no --jobs)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RUNS_JSON="$(gh run list --repo "$REPO" --workflow "$WORKFLOW" --limit "$LIMIT" --json databaseId,event,createdAt,updatedAt,conclusion)" || fail "gh run list failed"

RUN_COUNT="$(echo "$RUNS_JSON" | jq 'length')"
if [[ -z "$RUN_COUNT" || "$RUN_COUNT" -eq 0 ]]; then
  fail "run list is empty (workflow=${WORKFLOW}, limit=${LIMIT})"
fi

FILTERED_RUNS="$RUNS_JSON"
if [[ -n "$SINCE" ]]; then
  FILTERED_RUNS="$(echo "$FILTERED_RUNS" | jq --arg since "$SINCE" 'map(select(.createdAt >= $since))')"
fi
if [[ -n "$EVENT" ]]; then
  FILTERED_RUNS="$(echo "$FILTERED_RUNS" | jq --arg event "$EVENT" 'map(select(.event == $event))')"
fi

FILTERED_COUNT="$(echo "$FILTERED_RUNS" | jq 'length')"
if [[ -z "$FILTERED_COUNT" || "$FILTERED_COUNT" -eq 0 ]]; then
  fail "no runs remain after --since/--event filtering (workflow=${WORKFLOW}, limit=${LIMIT})"
fi

if [[ "$MODE" == "wall" ]]; then
  ENTRIES="$(echo "$FILTERED_RUNS" | jq '
    [.[] | (((.updatedAt|fromdate) - (.createdAt|fromdate)) as $raw
      | (if $raw < 0 then 0 else $raw end)) as $dur
    | {event: .event, conclusion: .conclusion, duration: $dur}]
  ')"
else
  # jobspan: one `gh run view --json jobs` round-trip per run in the (already
  # since/event-filtered) window.
  ENTRIES="[]"
  while IFS= read -r row; do
    id="$(echo "$row" | jq -r '.databaseId')"
    ev="$(echo "$row" | jq -r '.event')"
    concl="$(echo "$row" | jq -r '.conclusion')"
    JOBS_FOR_RUN="$(gh run view "$id" --repo "$REPO" --json jobs)" || fail "gh run view failed for run ${id} (jobspan sweep)"
    dur="$(echo "$JOBS_FOR_RUN" | jq '
      (.jobs | map(.completedAt|fromdate) | max) as $maxc
      | (.jobs | map(.startedAt|fromdate) | min) as $mins
      | (($maxc - $mins) as $raw | if $raw < 0 then 0 else $raw end)
    ')" || fail "empty or malformed job list for run ${id} (jobspan sweep)"
    ENTRIES="$(echo "$ENTRIES" | jq --arg event "$ev" --arg conclusion "$concl" --argjson duration "$dur" '. + [{event: $event, conclusion: $conclusion, duration: $duration}]')"
  done < <(echo "$FILTERED_RUNS" | jq -c '.[]')
fi

STATS="$(echo "$ENTRIES" | jq '
  group_by(.event) | map({
    trigger: .[0].event,
    n: length,
    durations: (map(.duration) | sort),
    pass: (map(select(.conclusion == "success")) | length)
  } | . + {
    fail: (.n - .pass),
    mean: ((.durations | add) / .n),
    p50: (.durations[(.n / 2 | floor)]),
    max: (.durations | max)
  })
')"

case "$FORMAT" in
  json)
    echo "$STATS" | jq '[.[] | {trigger, n, mean_seconds: .mean, p50_seconds: .p50, max_seconds: .max, pass, fail}]'
    ;;
  table)
    {
      printf '| trigger | n | mean | p50 | max | outcomes |\n'
      printf '| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n'
      echo "$STATS" | jq -r '.[] | [.trigger, .n, .mean, .p50, .max, .pass, .fail] | @tsv' \
        | while IFS=$'\t' read -r trigger n mean p50 max passn failn; do
            mean_m=$(awk -v s="$mean" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", s/60}')
            p50_m=$(awk -v s="$p50" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", s/60}')
            max_m=$(awk -v s="$max" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", s/60}')
            printf '| %s | %s | %sm | %sm | %sm | %s pass / %s fail |\n' \
              "$trigger" "$n" "$mean_m" "$p50_m" "$max_m" "$passn" "$failn"
          done
    }
    ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Self-test for ci-run-metrics.sh (Phase 230 / D-21 / SC-5).
#
# Hermetic: no real `gh` CLI or network call. A recording stub `gh` is placed first on
# PATH; it logs every invocation's argv and returns a scripted `gh run view --json jobs`
# payload so each case can assert exactly what the script under test computed.
#
# Test cases (mirrors the plan's <behavior> block):
#   A: canned run -> per-job table with name, conclusion, duration in both `Ns` and
#      `NmSSs` form.
#   B: `Admin eval render + probe (evidence only, not a merge gate)` (conclusion
#      "failure", continue-on-error) appears with duration 1053s / 17m33s -- NOT
#      filtered out for a non-"success" conclusion.
#   C: `Upgrade smoke` has a `completedAt` 1s before `startedAt` -> reported duration is
#      `0`, never negative.
#   D: unknown flag -> exit 2, `ci-run-metrics: FAIL: unknown arg: <arg>` on stderr,
#      fail-closed with ZERO recorded `gh` invocations (arg parsing fails before any
#      gh call is made).
#   E: `gh` absent from PATH -> exit non-zero, `ci-run-metrics: FAIL:` on stderr.
#   F: `gh` exits non-zero -> exit non-zero, `ci-run-metrics: FAIL:` on stderr, no
#      partial table on stdout.
#   G: empty job list -> exit non-zero, `ci-run-metrics: FAIL:` on stderr, no partial
#      table on stdout.
#   H: `--format json` emits valid JSON with the same duration/clamp/filter semantics.
#
# Task 2 (windowed baseline-reproduction mode) cases:
#   I: window mode emits the exact header `| trigger | n | mean | p50 | max | outcomes |`
#      and correct per-trigger n/mean/p50/max/outcomes, pinning the p50 index rule
#      (sort ascending, 0-based index floor(n/2)) against BOTH a fixed odd-length group
#      (pull_request, n=5) and a fixed even-length group (push, n=4).
#   J: a run whose `updatedAt` precedes its `createdAt` (schedule, n=1) reports duration
#      `0`, never negative -- same clamp rule as the single-run mode.
#   K: `--mode jobspan` produces a strictly smaller mean than `--mode wall` on the exact
#      same canned window (job-span excludes queue time).
#   L: an empty run list (`gh run list` returns `[]`) -> exit non-zero, `ci-run-metrics:
#      FAIL:` on stderr, no partial table on stdout (fail-closed).
#
# No network access and no GH_TOKEN are required or read anywhere in this file.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
SCRIPT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/ci-run-metrics.sh"

diagnosis_contract() {
  python3 - "$SCRIPT" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tarfile, tempfile, unittest

script = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
root = script.parents[2]
phase = root / 'test/fixtures/ci-metrics/archived-diagnosis'

class DiagnosisContract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fixture_members_keep_their_original_hashes_and_cannot_claim_acceptance(self):
        provenance = json.loads((phase / 'provenance.json').read_text())
        self.assertTrue(provenance['fixture_only'])
        self.assertTrue(json.loads((phase / 'baseline.json').read_text())['fixture_only'])
        with tarfile.open(phase / 'source.tar.gz') as archive:
            manifest = json.load(archive.extractfile('manifest.json'))
            self.assertTrue(manifest['fixture_only'])
            self.assertEqual(manifest['status'], 'test_fixture_only')
            actual = {member.name: hashlib.sha256(archive.extractfile(member).read()).hexdigest()
                      for member in archive.getmembers() if member.isfile() and member.name != 'manifest.json'}
        self.assertEqual(actual, provenance['retained_original_members'])

    def test_late_failure_context_and_incomplete_inputs(self):
        sys.path.insert(0, str(script.parent))
        import ci_metrics_security as security
        select = getattr(security, 'select_failure_context', None)
        self.assertTrue(callable(select), 'failure context must be selected before display clipping')
        raw = ('PASS: expected negative probe FAIL remains expected\n' * 3000 +
               'FAIL: original late assertion\nBearer secret-token\n').encode()
        context = select(raw, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
        self.assertIn('original late assertion', context['text'])
        self.assertNotIn('secret-token', context['text'])
        self.assertGreater(context['source_line_start'], 2900)
        self.assertFalse(context['truncated'])
        self.assertEqual(context['input_sha256'], hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
        self.assertEqual(select(b'PASS: expected FAIL banner\n', hashlib.sha256(b'PASS: expected FAIL banner\n').hexdigest())['completeness'], 'incomplete')
        self.assertEqual(select(raw, '0' * 64)['completeness'], 'incomplete')
        clipped = b'FAIL: assertion\n' + b'x' * 20000
        self.assertTrue(select(clipped, hashlib.sha256(clipped).hexdigest())['truncated'])

    def test_changed_archive_fails_closed_with_saved_diagnostic(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            archive = pathlib.Path(directory) / 'changed.tar.gz'
            archive.write_bytes((phase / 'source.tar.gz').read_bytes() + b'changed')
            output = pathlib.Path(directory) / 'diagnosis.json'
            result = subprocess.run(['bash', str(script), '--diagnose-v1', '--source-bundle',
                str(archive), '--baseline', str(phase / 'baseline.json'), '--output', str(output)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
            self.assertIn('source_bundle_hash_mismatch', json.loads(output.read_text())['source_errors'])

    def test_archived_test_z_preserves_red_and_passing_test_d(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            output = pathlib.Path(directory) / 'diagnosis.json'
            result = subprocess.run(['bash', str(script), '--diagnose-v1', '--source-bundle',
                str(phase / 'source.tar.gz'), '--baseline',
                str(phase / 'baseline.json'), '--output', str(output)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, 'saved-family diagnosis must succeed: ' + result.stderr)
            data = json.loads(output.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(data['schema_version'], 'sigra.ci-diagnosis/v1')
            self.assertEqual(data['source_bundle_sha256'], hashlib.sha256((phase / 'source.tar.gz').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
            for run in ('38314896976', '38316396580'):
                records = [r for r in data['records'] if r['run_id'] == run]
                selected = [r for r in records if r['step_name'] == 'CI run metrics self-test']
                self.assertEqual(len(selected), 1)
                record = selected[0]
                self.assertEqual(record['original_native_outcome'], 'failure')
                self.assertEqual(record['corrected_category'], 'historical_metrics_dependency_failure')
                self.assertEqual(record['observed_test'], 'Test Z')
                self.assertEqual(record['rejected_signature_status'], 'passing_test_d')
                self.assertEqual(record['completeness'], 'complete')
                self.assertTrue(record['log_sha256'])
                self.assertTrue(any(r['completeness'] == 'incomplete' for r in records))

unittest.main(argv=[sys.argv[0]], verbosity=2)
PY
}

def bind(directory, doc, approval_edit=None, allocation_edit=None):

    digest = sha256(requests.read_bytes())
    approval = {"schema_version": "sigra.phase253.shape-probe-approval/v1", "decision": "approve",
                "decided_by": "253-126 test", "decision_text": "approve", "note": "", "section": "shape_probe",
                "section_sha256": digest, "requests_path": str(requests), "authorizes": ["the five GETs"],
                "excludes": ["any write"], "recorded_at": "2026-10-16T00:00:00Z"}
    if approval_edit:
        approval_edit(approval)
    approval_path = write_json(directory / "approval.json", approval)
    allocation = {"schema_version": "sigra.phase253.http-allocation/v1", "allocation_kind": "canary", "mode": "live",
                  "repository": doc.get("repository"), "window_id": doc.get("window_id"), "source_sha256": digest,
                  "max_requests": doc.get("max_requests"), "max_elapsed_seconds": doc.get("max_elapsed_seconds"),
                  "max_response_bytes": doc.get("max_response_bytes"), "max_pages": doc.get("max_pages"),

                  "download_hosts": list(doc.get("download_hosts") or [])}
    if allocation_edit:

class FakeHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    """Answers by Host header and journals every request it actually received."""
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def _answer(self):
        host = (self.headers.get("Host") or "").split(":", 1)[0].lower()
        route = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
        status, headers, payload = self.server.routes.get(
            (host, self.path), self.server.routes.get((host, route), (404, [], b'{"message":"Not Found"}')))
        self.send_response(status)
        for name, value in headers:
            self.send_header(name, value)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(payload)
        self.server.journal.append({"method": self.command, "host": host, "path": self.path, "status": status,
                                    "authorization": self.headers.get("Authorization")})

    do_GET = do_POST = do_PUT = do_PATCH = do_DELETE = _answer  # noqa: N815

    def log_message(self, *_args):
        pass


class ShimCase(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.class_tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sigra-253-126-tls-")
        cls.cert, key = SHIM.make_tls_identity(pathlib.Path(cls.class_tmp.name), (
            API, "*.actions.githubusercontent.com", "*.blob.core.windows.net", UNTRUSTED))
        cls.server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), FakeHandler)
        context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
        context.load_cert_chain(cls.cert, key)
        cls.server.socket = context.wrap_socket(cls.server.socket, server_side=True)
        cls.thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        cls.thread.start()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.server.shutdown()
        cls.server.server_close()
        cls.thread.join()
        cls.class_tmp.cleanup()

    def setUp(self):
        tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sigra-253-126-")
        self.addCleanup(tmp.cleanup)
        self.tmp = pathlib.Path(tmp.name)
        self.root = _SCRATCH["root"]
        self.server.routes = {}
        self.server.journal = []
        self.connect_log = self.tmp / "connect.jsonl"
        self.refusal_log = SHIM.refusal_log_for(self.connect_log)
        self.shim_env = SHIM.prepare(self.tmp / "site", {host: self.server.server_address[1] for host in SHIM_HOSTS},
                                     self.cert, self.connect_log)
        self.records = {"ledger": self.tmp / "ledger.json", "evidence": self.tmp / "evidence.json",
                        "bodies": self.tmp / "bodies.json"}

    def env(self):
        env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
               if key not in {"GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN", "PYTHONPATH"} and not key.startswith("SIGRA_")}
        env.update(self.shim_env)
        env["GH_TOKEN"] = DUMMY_TOKEN
        return env

    def driver(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(["python3", str(self.root / DRIVER_REL), *map(str, args)], cwd=self.root, env=self.env(),
                              text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120)

    def check_only(self, paths):
        return self.driver("--check-only", "--requests", paths["requests"], "--allocation", paths["allocation"],
                           "--approval", paths["approval"])

    def run_probe(self, paths):
        return self.driver("--run", "--requests", paths["requests"], "--allocation", paths["allocation"],
                           "--approval", paths["approval"], "--ledger", self.records["ledger"],
                           "--evidence", self.records["evidence"], "--bodies", self.records["bodies"])

    def connects(self):
        return [(row["host"], row["port"]) for row in SHIM.read_log(self.connect_log)]

    def assert_no_socket(self):
        self.assertEqual(SHIM.read_log(self.connect_log), [])
        self.assertEqual(SHIM.read_log(self.refusal_log), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.server.journal, [])

    def assert_refused(self, result, field):
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(f"ci-shape-probe: REFUSED: {field}:", result.stderr)
        self.assert_no_socket()
        for path in self.records.values():
            self.assertFalse(path.exists(), f"{path.name} was written by a refused run")
            self.assertFalse(pathlib.Path(str(path) + ".lock").exists())

                                    str(request), "--output", os.devnull], cwd=self.root, env=self.env(), text=True,
                                   capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        self.assertEqual(transport.returncode, 0, transport.stderr)
        self.assert_no_socket()

    def test_check_only_refuses_each_allocation_field_that_differs_from_the_request_list(self):
        def hosts(change):
            return lambda item: item.update(download_hosts=change(list(item["download_hosts"])))
        cases = {
            "window_id": ("window_id", lambda item: item.update(window_id="253-126-another-window")),
            "max_requests": ("max_requests", lambda item: item.update(max_requests=9)),
            "max_elapsed_seconds": ("max_elapsed_seconds", lambda item: item.update(max_elapsed_seconds=599)),
            "max_response_bytes": ("max_response_bytes", lambda item: item.update(max_response_bytes=2097152)),
            "max_pages": ("max_pages", lambda item: item.update(max_pages=1)),
            "max_hops": ("max_hops", lambda item: item.update(max_hops=1)),
            "category_limits": ("category_limits", lambda item: item.update(
                category_limits=dict(CATEGORY_LIMITS, job_log_shape=2, cancelled_shape=2))),
            "repository": ("repository", lambda item: item.update(repository="szTheory/sigra-fork")),
            "download_hosts without results-receiver": ("download_hosts", hosts(
                lambda value: [host for host in value if host != RESULTS_RECEIVER])),
            "download_hosts with an extra trusted blob host": ("download_hosts", hosts(
                lambda value: value + ["productionresultssa41.blob.core.windows.net"])),
            "download_hosts reordered": ("download_hosts", hosts(lambda value: [value[1], value[0]] + value[2:])),
        }
        for name, (field, edit) in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(field=name):
                for path in self.records.values():
                    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                paths = self.rebind(allocation_edit=edit)
                self.assertNotEqual(json.loads(paths["allocation"].read_text()),
                                    json.loads(self.paths["allocation"].read_text()))
                self.assert_refused(self.check_only(paths), f"allocation.{field}")
                self.assert_run_refused(paths, f"allocation.{field}")

    def test_check_requests_refuses_each_missing_or_altered_field(self):
        cases = {f"without {field}": (f"list.{field}", lambda doc, field=field: doc.pop(field)) for field in LIST_FIELDS}
        cases.update({
            "an unknown field": ("list.extra_field", lambda doc: doc.update(extra_field=True)),
            "a source pointer sha256 altered": ("list.source_pointers[0].sha256", lambda doc: doc["source_pointers"][0].update(
                sha256="0" * 64)),
            "driver_commit not an ancestor": ("list.driver_commit", lambda doc: doc.update(driver_commit=_SCRATCH["orphan"])),
            "driver_commit with the driver changed since": ("list.driver_commit", lambda doc: doc.update(
                driver_commit=_SCRATCH["old"])),
        })
        self.assertEqual(len(cases), len(LIST_FIELDS) + 4)
        for name, (field, edit) in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(case=name):
                doc = copy.deepcopy(self.doc)
                edit(doc)
                requests = write_json(self.tmp / "mutated-requests.json", doc)
                self.assert_refused(self.driver("--check-requests", requests), field)

    def test_the_driver_imports_no_http_client_of_its_own(self):
        driver = (ROOT / DRIVER_REL).read_text()
        self.assertEqual(NO_HTTP_IMPORT.findall(driver), [])
        # Positive control: the SAME pattern finds the transport's own HTTP client imports.
        self.assertTrue(NO_HTTP_IMPORT.search((ROOT / TRANSPORT_REL).read_text()))
        self.assertTrue(NO_HTTP_IMPORT.search("from http import client\n"))
        for name in ("request_one", "fetch_pages", "follow_download", "_scrub_text"):
            self.assertIn(f"transport.{name}", driver)


class ProbeRehearsalTests(ShimCase):
    """The approved five GETs, end to end through the real transport under a live allocation."""

        self.doc = request_list()
        self.paths = bind(self.tmp, self.doc)
        ledger47 = [row for row in json.loads((ROOT / R10_LEDGER_REL).read_text())["transactions"] if row["sequence"] == 47]
        self.assertEqual(len(ledger47), 1)

        self.log_path = location["path"]

                        ("X-RateLimit-Remaining", "4990")]
        repo = "/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions"
        self.server.routes = {
            (API, "/rate_limit"): (200, json_headers, b'{"resources":{"core":{"limit":5000,"remaining":4990}}}'),
            (API, f"{repo}/runs/{CANCELLED_RUN}"): (200, json_headers, json.dumps(run).encode()),
            (API, f"{repo}/runs/{CANCELLED_RUN}/jobs"): (200, json_headers, json.dumps(jobs).encode()),
            (API, f"{repo}/jobs/{FAILED_JOB}/logs"): (302, [
                ("Content-Type", "text/html;charset=utf-8"),
                ("Location", f"https://{BLOB}/actions-results/job-logs.txt?sig=job-synthetic-253-126")], b""),

                ("Location", f"https://{RESULTS_RECEIVER}{self.log_path}?sig=synthetic-253-126&se=2026-10-16")], b""),

    def records_text(self):
        return "".join(path.read_text() for path in self.records.values() if path.exists())

    def load(self, name):
        return json.loads(self.records[name].read_text())

    def assert_token_only_on_api(self):
        for row in self.server.journal:
            self.assertEqual(row["method"], "GET")
            self.assertEqual(row["authorization"], f"Bearer {DUMMY_TOKEN}" if row["host"] == API else None, row)
        self.assertNotIn(DUMMY_TOKEN, self.records_text())
        self.assertNotIn("synthetic-253-126", self.records_text())

    def assert_common(self, evidence, ledger):
        self.assertEqual(evidence["schema_version"], "sigra.phase253.shape-probe-evidence/v1")
        self.assertEqual(evidence["window_id"], "253-126-rehearsal-window")
        self.assertEqual(evidence["requests_sha256"], sha256(self.paths["requests"].read_bytes()))
        self.assertEqual(evidence["approval_sha256"], sha256(self.paths["approval"].read_bytes()))
        self.assertEqual(evidence["allocation_sha256"], sha256(self.paths["allocation"].read_bytes()))
        self.assertEqual(evidence["driver_commit"], _SCRATCH["head"])
        self.assertIsInstance(evidence["window_wall_start_epoch"], int)
        self.assertLessEqual(evidence["window_wall_start_epoch"], evidence["ended_epoch"])
        self.assertEqual(evidence["request_count"], len(ledger["transactions"]))
        self.assertEqual(evidence["transport_ledger"], ledger)
        self.assertTrue(all(row["method"] == "GET" for row in ledger["transactions"]))
        self.assertTrue(all(row["host"] == API or row["route_id"] == "run_logs" for row in ledger["transactions"]))
        self.assertFalse(pathlib.Path(str(self.records["ledger"]) + ".lock").exists())
        self.assertEqual(SHIM.read_log(self.refusal_log), [])

    def test_live_probe_records_the_seq47_chain_to_results_receiver(self):
        result = self.run_probe(self.paths)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        evidence, ledger, bodies = self.load("evidence"), self.load("ledger"), self.load("bodies")
        self.assertEqual(evidence["status"], "complete")
        self.assertIsNone(evidence["stop"])
        self.assert_common(evidence, ledger)
        self.assertEqual([(row["route_id"], row["hop_ordinal"] or 0, row["host"], row["actual_status"])
                          for row in ledger["transactions"]],
                         [("rate_limit", 0, API, 200), ("run", 0, API, 200), ("run_jobs", 0, API, 200),
                          ("job_logs", 0, API, 302), ("run_logs", 0, API, 302), ("run_logs", 1, RESULTS_RECEIVER, 200)])
        self.assertEqual(self.connects(), [(API, 443)] * 5 + [(RESULTS_RECEIVER, 443)])
        self.assert_token_only_on_api()
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in evidence["results"]],
                         ["rate", "cancelled-run", "cancelled-jobs", "job-log-redirect", "run-log-chain"])
        by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in evidence["results"]}
        # job_logs: hop 0 only; its Location is recorded and no second socket is opened.
        job = by_id["job-log-redirect"]["observed"]["hops"]
        self.assertEqual(len(job), 1)
        self.assertEqual((job[0]["hop_ordinal"], job[0]["status"], job[0]["location"]["host"], job[0]["location"]["has_query"]),
                         (0, 302, BLOB, True))
        self.assertNotIn((BLOB, 443), self.connects())
        chain = by_id["run-log-chain"]["observed"]["hops"]
        self.assertEqual([(hop["hop_ordinal"], hop["host"], hop["status"]) for hop in chain],
                         [(0, API, 302), (1, RESULTS_RECEIVER, 200)])
        self.assertEqual(chain[0]["location"], {"host": RESULTS_RECEIVER, "path_pattern": "/rest/runs/{uuid}/logs",
                                                "has_query": True, "port": None})
        self.assertEqual(chain[0]["content_type"], "text/html;charset=utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(chain[0]["path_pattern"], "/repos/szTheory/sigra/actions/runs/{n}/logs")
        self.assertEqual(chain[1]["path_pattern"], "/rest/runs/{uuid}/logs")
        self.assertIn("location", chain[0]["safe_header_names"])
        self.assertEqual(len(by_id["run-log-chain"]["receipts"]), 2)
        entry = next(item for item in bodies["entries"] if item["id"] == "run-log-chain")
        self.assertEqual(bodies["schema_version"], "sigra.phase253.shape-probe-bodies/v1")
        self.assertEqual((entry["hop_ordinal"], entry["bytes"], entry["sha256"]), (1, len(log_zip()), sha256(log_zip())))
        self.assertEqual(entry["magic_hex"], log_zip()[:8].hex())
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(log_zip())) as archive:
            expected = [{"name": info.filename, "size": info.file_size, "compressed_size": info.compress_size,
                         "crc": info.CRC} for info in archive.infolist()]
        self.assertEqual(entry["zip_members"], expected)
        self.assertEqual(entry["token_scan"], "clean")
        self.assertEqual(base64.b64decode(entry["full_base64"]), log_zip())
        self.assertEqual([item["name"] for item in entry["head_sample_base64"]], [item["name"] for item in expected])
        json_entries = [item for item in bodies["entries"] if item["id"] in {"rate", "cancelled-run", "cancelled-jobs"}]
        self.assertEqual(len(json_entries), 3)
        for item in json_entries:
            self.assertEqual(set(item) - {"id", "hop_ordinal", "page_ordinal", "kind"}, {"sha256", "bytes"})

    def test_live_probe_halts_on_an_untrusted_hop_and_keeps_partial_records(self):
        self.server.routes[(RESULTS_RECEIVER, self.log_path)] = (302, [("Location", f"https://{UNTRUSTED}/logs.zip")], b"")
        result = self.run_probe(self.paths)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        evidence, ledger, bodies = self.load("evidence"), self.load("ledger"), self.load("bodies")
        self.assert_common(evidence, ledger)
        self.assertEqual(evidence["status"], "halted")
        self.assertEqual((evidence["stop"]["code"], evidence["stop"]["request_id"]), ("redirect_rejected", "run-log-chain"))
        self.assertEqual(ledger["terminal_stop"]["code"], "redirect_rejected")
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in evidence["results"]],
                         ["rate", "cancelled-run", "cancelled-jobs", "job-log-redirect", "run-log-chain"])
        self.assertEqual([item["status"] for item in evidence["results"]], ["complete"] * 4 + ["halted"])
        chain = evidence["results"][-1]["observed"]["hops"]
        self.assertEqual([(hop["host"], hop["status"]) for hop in chain], [(API, 302), (RESULTS_RECEIVER, 302)])
        self.assertEqual(chain[1]["location"]["host"], UNTRUSTED)
        self.assertEqual(len(ledger["transactions"]), 6)
        self.assertNotIn((UNTRUSTED, 443), self.connects())
        self.assertEqual(self.connects(), [(API, 443)] * 5 + [(RESULTS_RECEIVER, 443)])
        self.assertEqual({item["id"] for item in bodies["entries"]},
                         {"rate", "cancelled-run", "cancelled-jobs", "job-log-redirect"})
        self.assert_token_only_on_api()

    def test_live_probe_large_body_keeps_only_digest_and_head_sample(self):
        large = b"2026-10-16T20:35:00Z log line without secrets\n" * 6522
        large = large[:300000]
        self.assertEqual(len(large), 300000)
        self.server.routes[(RESULTS_RECEIVER, self.log_path)] = (200, [("Content-Type", "text/plain")], large)
        result = self.run_probe(self.paths)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        entry = next(item for item in self.load("bodies")["entries"] if item["id"] == "run-log-chain")
        self.assertEqual((entry["bytes"], entry["sha256"], entry["zip_members"]), (300000, sha256(large), None))
        self.assertEqual(entry["token_scan"], "clean")
        self.assertIsNone(entry["full_base64"])
        self.assertEqual(base64.b64decode(entry["head_sample_base64"]), large[:2048])
        self.assertNotIn(base64.b64encode(large[:6000]).decode(), self.records["bodies"].read_text())
        self.assert_token_only_on_api()
